propositions: The current `_pai_check_config` function raises an error when `base_url` or `api_key` are configured, contradicting documented recipes for local OpenAI-compatible servers (Ollama, LMStudio) and config parsing already in place.

The OpenAI provider builder must be registered only when `REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL` is set, and the `base_url` must remain provider configuration (not selection) — the provider choice still comes from the model string or `REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER`.

A custom endpoint's profile must override `supports_json_schema_output=False` via a rebar OpenAIProvider subclass to prevent silent wrong answers or parse errors from opaque servers lacking native schema output support.
The `openai` SDK must remain optional in the runtime `agents` extra but added to the `dev` extra only, so CI can test the end-to-end recipe without changing user-facing dependency posture.
The `base_url` configuration without an `api_key` and non-absolute `base_url` values must raise clear validation errors; missing the `pydantic-ai-slim[openai]` extra must name the install command.
